payload.description: An equality assessment of the policy that was actually adopted. The one in the papers was completed on 4 November 2025, before the consultation opened, and it assesses the version that went out to consultation. Officers then changed the rough sleeping proposal in response to what people said, and no revised assessment of the changed version has been published. The assessment does commit the council to reviewing the policy's impact a year after it started, in February 2027.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
